subject: Cloud marketplace listing & co-sell enablement for CloudBridge opportunity
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace Partner <aws-marketplace-partner@amazon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudBridge Partnerships <partnerships@cloudbridge.consulting>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Introduction: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell for Redwood / CloudBridge

Hi Marissa,

I work on the AWS Marketplace Alliances team — we reviewed the CloudBridge + Redwood PoC and wanted to propose a joint listing + co-sell motion to accelerate procurement for CloudBridge's customers. High level: list Redwood Inference on AWS Marketplace (SaaS listing), enable co-sell with the CloudBridge reseller tag, and add a joint go-to-market package for Q2.

Quick asks to start:
- Can you share a short product one-pager and a draft listing manifest (SKU, pricing model)?
- Do you have a SOC 2 or security evidence package we can reference on the listing?
- Any constraints for co-sell (discounting floor, SOW templates)?

If it helps, we can do a 30-min onboarding call this week and walk through the AWS listing checklist.

Best,
Katherine Lee
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
aws-marketplace-partner@amazon.com
[Attachment: aws-marketplace-onboarding-checklist.pdf (stub)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Partner <aws-marketplace-partner@amazon.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, CloudBridge Partnerships <partnerships@cloudbridge.consulting>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introduction: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell for Redwood / CloudBridge

Katherine — thanks for the note and for taking the time to review the PoC. We're excited about a joint listing + co-sell path.

I attached a concise one-pager for Redwood and a draft of our typical co-sell playbook. Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Jonas to assemble the listing manifest and technical artifacts (manifest, pricing SKU, SaaS metering config).
- Marcus will validate any necessary legal/pricing guardrails.
- Could you share the preferred timeline for publishing and any DocuSign links for the marketplace agreement?

Proposed internal owners: Jonas (technical manifest), Marcus (contracts/pricing), Lauren (field enablement).

Would appreciate a 30-min slot Thu or Fri to align.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-product-onepager.pdf (stub)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudBridge Partnerships <partnerships@cloudbridge.consulting>, AWS Marketplace Partner <aws-marketplace-partner@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introduction: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell for Redwood / CloudBridge

Adding the technical checklist and a first draft manifest for the SaaS listing. Notes:
- SKU model: per-concurrent-request plus token-based overage. Manifest includes both a metering lambda and a SaaS entitlements section (see attached yml).
- We need CloudBridge to confirm the reseller tag and desired pricing tier (standard vs. enterprise).
- For co-sell, we recommend a joint launch play with:
  - Joint webinar (field/AMs)
  - Co-branded datasheet in marketplace listing
  - A two-week pilot offer for customers who purchase via CloudBridge

Marcus — pinging you for any legal/pricing constraints. I've attached: redwood-aws-listing-manifest.yml and a draft SOW that outlines responsibilities.

-Jonas
Principal Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-aws-listing-manifest.yml (text stub)]
[Attachment: redwood-aws-sow-draft.pdf (stub)]

From: AWS Marketplace Partner <aws-marketplace-partner@amazon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudBridge Partnerships <partnerships@cloudbridge.consulting>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introduction: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell for Redwood / CloudBridge

Thanks everyone — this looks good. Two items before we can publish:
1) Marketplace agreement execution (I sent the DocuSign link below). Please have your legal team sign the AWS Marketplace Seller Agreement.
2) Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (or a SOC 2 attestation letter) + data flow diagram for SaaS metering. We can host the evidence in the AWS security portal for the listing.

Timeline: if we get the signed agreement and security artifacts by 3/13, we can aim for a 3/26 public listing and co-sell enablement week of 3/30.

Also, for co-sell enablement, we'll need 1-2 internal enablement slots (30–45 mins) with CloudBridge field sellers — Lauren, can your team lead that?

Link: DocuSign — https://www.docusign.net/embeddedSigning/1234567890

Best,
Katherine Lee
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
aws-marketplace-partner@amazon.com
[Attachment: aws-security-evidence-checklist.pdf (stub)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Team — consolidating action items and owners so we can hit the 3/26 target: 
- Marcus: review/redline the Marketplace Seller Agreement in DocuSign by 3/11. (Attachment: co-sell-playbook.docx for pricing guardrail refs)
- Jonas: finalize manifest + SaaS metering lambda and upload YAML to the AWS console by 3/12. (Attached draft manifest)
- Lauren: schedule two 45-min enablement sessions with CloudBridge sellers for week of 3/30; prepare co-branded datasheet.
- Myself: deliver final one-pager and coordinate packaging for the joint webinar.

CloudBridge — if you can confirm the reseller tag and preferred pilot pricing (discount %) by EOD 3/10 that would unblock the manifest.
